correctness.rationale: For n>=4, no-three-consecutive face condition equals the cycle two-independence condition. The signed fixed-face Lefschetz formula includes the augmentation; 4-state matrix has characteristic polynomial x(x-1)(x^2+1), hence cyclic trace 1+2cos(pi h/2) for every h>=1, including h=1,2. Reflection orbit-bit endpoint restrictions give B_L=(-1)^floor(L/2). With the cited top-homology concentration this determines characters and quotient invariants in all congruence classes. Independently recomputed signed fixed-orbit traces on 198 dihedral group elements for n=4..14, with no mismatch; finite check corroborates the all-n transfer argument, not a substitute for it.
residual_risks: Finite n<=14 tests alone do not prove all n; all-n proof uses transfer and concentration.
